answer: Use content-addressed unique work with a quartz-timed registry: every rewarded task is hashed and logged once, and any echo of the same work from a second identity earns nothing, so a Sybil farm copying one job across a thousand identities is paid once. To claim new work, an agent must post a jade bond that is slashed if its submission is a duplicate or junk. Honest agents keep their bond and build a history of distinct, verified tasks; attackers must fund a fresh bond and do genuinely new work for every identity, which makes bulk forgery cost as much as honest work.
